intro.label: Product roadmap
intro.title: Where we're headed
intro.description: What is implemented today, what still needs work, and what comes later. Chat, calls, article reading, check-ins, and fitness now work on both web and iOS alongside the core feed. Done means implemented in the current app; it does not mean App Store approval or availability on every platform. The original milestone dates below are historical targets.

phases.title: Close the gaps between the app and the promise
phases.description: The current build has grown beyond the original milestones. These additions and release gaps are now tracked explicitly.

items.text: **Voice and video calls** — Web and iOS calling in eligible chats, up to 4 participants, with native incoming-call integration, reactions, and missed-call handling.

**Fitness and Apple Health** — Verified personal accounts can track workouts, steps, activity, weight, VO2 max, and goals. Apple Health connects through iOS; synced progress is available on web. Data is private unless you deliberately share a post.
**Premium recovery summaries** — Sleep and HRV summaries are available to Premium members when their connected Health data includes those readings.
**Video avatars and richer media** — Premium video avatars, media cropping, supported external embeds, and an iOS Share Extension for bringing content into posts or chats.

**Marv privacy and personal tools** — Explicit AI consent, personal context controls, memory management, and catch-up tools. Marv can use public content and permitted context from the thread or group where he participates. Usage is limited by a separate Marv credit allowance.
**Account switching and managed Pages** — Account switching is implemented on web and iOS. Admin-managed Pages and operators exist; Pages do not receive person-only fitness, check-in, or Crew access.
**Spaces scheduling** — Schedule a Space and let members subscribe to reminders on the web. This does not yet provide a general event / RSVP system.
**Publishing and operations** — Newsletter editing, scheduling, audience targeting, unsubscribe controls, and admin job/media tools are implemented.
**Scripture previews** — Recognized scripture references open verse previews on web and iOS; tap-any-word dictionary lookup is still separate planned work.

**iOS release validation** — Complete manual iPhone/iPad TestFlight checks, purchase and restore scenarios, review-account access, and App Store resubmission. Native implementation is not App Store approval.
**Strava rollout** — OAuth, sync, disconnect, and UI are implemented behind an account feature flag. Complete provider/rollout validation before advertising general availability.

**Ranking policy** — Align ranking and membership claims. Boost and profile-pin weights vary by tier, and people recommendations give Premium+ extra weight. Decide and enforce the intended policy before claiming paid-tier neutrality.

**Steward benefits** — Deliver the planned forum, founder updates/calls, and support workflow before presenting them as active Premium+ perks. Premium+ already includes Premium, supporter styling, and an additional people-recommendation weight.
**Account control** — Add data export, per-device session revocation, and a verified phone-number change/recovery flow.
**Safety follow-through** — Add user muting across feeds, report outcome/status visibility, and chat read-receipt preferences.
**Writing continuity** — Make saved composer drafts discoverable and resumable, then finish continuous post autosave and cross-device recovery. Native article writing is also still planned.
**API observability** — Add API error tracking and actionable alerts alongside existing web/iOS monitoring.

phases.title: Early Beta: join, verify, and participate safely
phases.description: Make it easy to join and read, verify for trust, and gate participation by tier. Ship account states, reporting, and paid membership with enforced entitlements.

items.text: **Account states** — Active / suspended / banned with consistent enforcement (posting, messaging, uploads, and real-time connections).

**Identity verification** — Request verification, follow its status, and receive an administrator’s approval or rejection. Admins can revoke verification. An automated external identity-provider flow is not implemented.
**Premium requires verification** — Verify before starting a web or App Store purchase. Paid entitlements are withheld when verification is lost; Apple subscription management remains with Apple.

**Unverified read-only (plus private notes)** — Read public posts and longform, follow, bookmark, and manage profile basics; create Only Me private notes. Public posting, replies, and reactions require verification.

**Verified participation** — React, post, and reply within limits (rate limits may be lower than Premium; configurable by admins); post **images and GIFs** (video is Premium); create **polls**; use **bookmark folders/collections**; send **coins** to other verified members; **start DMs with mutuals** (people who follow you back); men-only read areas; no dialogues.
**Premium access** — Longer posts, Premium-only content, video, chats with verified non-mutuals, open or private group creation, and scheduled posts. Audience restrictions and moderation still apply.
**Spaces on web** — Host or join rooms with presence, live chat, radio playback, and synchronized YouTube watch parties. A native iOS Spaces experience remains planned.

**Stripe subscriptions** — Premium ($25/mo) and Premium+ ($75/mo) billing with verification gating; entitlements are enforced in the upgrade flow and settings. Steward services beyond current Premium+ benefits remain planned.
**Landing & onboarding** — Clear homepage and signup; smooth onboarding so you can post and follow in your first session.
**Discover / non-empty feed** — When you have zero follows, a "Discover" or "For you" feed (trending or recent public posts) so your home feed is never empty.
**Suggested users / who to follow** — Real "who to follow" (by interests or activity) so you fill your feed fast and see content that matters.
**Daily momentum loops** — Check-ins feed + leaderboard to reward consistency and visible streak progress.

**Coins & streak rewards** — Earn coins automatically from daily streaks with escalating multipliers (1x–4x based on consecutive days); send coins to other verified members; full transfer history and receipt pages; admin coin adjustments.
**Invites and referral rewards** — Share invite links and codes, track recruits, and earn qualifying subscription credits. Eligibility and reward status are shown in web Billing.
**Pinned profile post** — Pin one post to the top of your profile so visitors see what matters most.
**Repost / quote post** — One-tap repost or quote with your own commentary; shows in your followers' feeds.
**Link previews** — Paste a URL in a post and get a rich preview card (title, image, description); refreshed in the background.
**GIF picker (Giphy)** — Browse and attach GIFs in the composer via a server-side Giphy proxy. Available to all verified members.
**Push notifications** — Reply, follow, and boost notifications so you never miss a beat.
**Email re-engagement (v1)** — Daily digest, "you have new notifications" nudges, and instant high-signal emails (provider: Resend).
**PWA / Add to home screen** — Install the app on your phone (icon, splash, offline where useful) for an app-like experience without the app store.
**Report post / Report user** — "Report" in the post menu and on profiles; pick a reason and add details; we store it and admins can triage.
**Feedback** — Send us bugs and ideas; we store and triage so we can improve.
**Reliability foundations** — Rate limits, user-facing errors, local contract checks, and purchase failure tests are implemented. Device testing and release validation remain ongoing.
**Error monitoring** — Web and iOS have Sentry integrations. API error tracking still needs integration and end-to-end alert verification.
**Third-party analytics (minimal)** — Track the key funnel events (join, verify submitted/approved, first post, follow, upgrade) so we can measure what's working.
**Hydration hardening** — Ongoing SSR/client mismatch fixes and guardrails to reduce front-end render regressions.
**Terms of Service + Privacy Policy** — Public legal pages so members know the rules and their rights.

phases.badge: Phase 2 — A site that's full of life
phases.title: Discovery, content & polish
phases.description: Improve discovery and polish, but keep trust tight: SEO boundaries (robots, sitemap, canonical + share previews) and stronger reporting triage. Add post editing with limits and version history, drafts/autosave, and start integrations with webhooks. Subscription management and notification controls round it out.

items.text: Explore / trending with real data — Trending or popular posts and "who to follow" in Explore or the right rail, so discovery feels alive.
Hashtags & topics (v1) — Add hashtags to posts and simple topic pages so you can find and follow themes that matter to you.
**Local discovery** — State and location feeds so you can see who’s building in your state.
**Edit post (with limits + history)** — You can edit up to **3 times in 30 minutes**; posts show an **edited** label; we keep previous versions so we can review changes.

**Post drafts and autosave** — Web offers a save-on-leave prompt, but saved composer drafts are not listed in Only Me and still need a retrieval/resume screen. Continuous autosave and cross-device recovery remain incomplete. Article autosave is implemented.
**Admin-only restore** — Restore soft-deleted posts (admin-only for now).
**No advertising placements** — The app has no paid ad placements. Feed and people recommendations currently use membership weights; ranking policy is tracked in the current priorities.
**Polls (v1)** — Verified members can create polls; poll results notifications are delivered cleanly in notifications.
**Bookmark collections (v1)** — Verified members can save posts into folders and manage bookmark organization from a dedicated bookmarks surface.
Manage subscription — Stripe customer portal (manage or cancel) via Settings → Billing.
**Scheduled posts** — Write now, publish later; manage everything queued from a dedicated screen. On web and iOS.
**Member status** — Set a short, expiring status on your profile so people know what you're working on.
**Weekly missions** — Milestone-style weekly goals surfaced in the home feed to encourage consistent engagement.

**Marv AI** — Premium members can use Marv in supported threads and chats within their Marv credit allowance. AI consent, optional personal context, and memory controls are implemented; private context stays subject to its permissions.
**Report queue** — Admin list with filters (post vs user, category) and resolution states (pending, dismissed, action taken).
Optional: we notify you when we've taken action (or you can check report status in-app), so you know we're on it.
**Robots control** — Keep private/restricted surfaces out of search; environment-aware rules.
**Sitemap** — A sitemap for public profiles and public posts only; restricted tiers never appear.
**Canonical + share previews** — Canonical URLs everywhere; share previews never leak restricted content. Premium content also respects the rule: **premium requires verified**.
**RSS / Atom / JSON feeds** — Subscribe to articles, topics, and any member's public posts in your own reader; browsable feed directory.
**Public read API** — Documented read-only endpoints for public posts and profiles.
Notification preferences — Choose what you get: mute replies, only chats, no boost notifications, etc.; per type or global.
**Radio in Spaces** — Listen to supported audio streams with room chat and reactions on the web. The old /radio route redirects to Spaces; a separate native radio screen is not implemented.
**Watch party** — Sync a YouTube video so a room watches together with live chat reactions.
**Admin analytics dashboard** — Key platform metrics (DAU/MAU, content, growth) visible to admins.
**Admin site settings** — Feature flags and site-wide config manageable by admins without a deploy.

**Admin media review** — Review uploaded media, inspect content ownership, and remove eligible orphaned media. This is an admin review tool, not a claim that every upload is approved before publication.

phases.title: Groups, Chat, safety & data
phases.description: Ship deeper ways to connect (groups, dialogues, chat), strengthen safety controls, and add the first longform publishing path (articles). Add real-time post-thread updates so conversations feel alive. Keep compliance minimal but real (delete/export).

items.text: Groups (v1) — Create and join groups; group feed or group-scoped posts so you have pockets of accountability and conversation.
**Crew / Founding Circles** — Small private invite-only communities; founding members invite each other, share a dedicated wall, and can grow with a waitlist.
Dialogues (v1) — Start and participate in structured dialogues (premium required).

**Chat** — Direct and group conversations on web and iOS, with message requests, photos, voice notes, Premium video messages, replies, reactions, search, read receipts, and per-conversation notification muting. Chat is access-controlled; this is not a claim of end-to-end message encryption.
**Articles (v1)** — A separate longform editor (rich text/markdown with safe rendering), drafts + autosave, publish/unpublish, and SEO-friendly public pages; views, boosts, reactions, and comments.
**Live thread updates** — New replies, edits, deletes, and engagement changes update without a page refresh. Admin restoration of deleted posts remains planned.
**Block user** — Block interactions and remove blocked accounts from your signed-in experience; manage the block list in Settings. Public content can still be seen while signed out.
Mute user — "See less"; hide their posts in your feed without unfollowing.

**Delete account** — Request deletion inside web or iOS Settings, with immediate sign-out, a recovery window, and deletion-status tracking. The deletion worker removes personal content and fitness data and cancels Stripe billing; Apple subscriptions must be managed separately through Apple.
Download my data — Export your posts, profile, and bookmarks so you own your data.
**Active sessions / devices** — Sign out everywhere is implemented. A device/session list with individual revocation remains to be built.
Public status page or link so you can check uptime; in-app Help/Contact so you can reach us.

phases.title: Native iOS app
phases.description: The current iOS app implements feed, groups, chat, calls, article reading, fitness, check-in day feeds, and account controls on the shared API. Article writing, coins, Crews, and Spaces still use web surfaces. TestFlight validation and App Store approval remain separate release milestones.

items.text: **Home feed** — Read, post, reply, and boost; real-time updates via websockets.
**Post detail + threads** — Full thread view with the whole ancestor chain, paginated replies, and post actions. Deeper nesting opens as its own screen rather than an inline tree.
**Composer** — Write posts, replies, quotes, and check-ins.
**Repost / quote post** — One-tap repost or quote with your own commentary; see everyone who reposted.
**Explore + search** — Discover trending posts, people, groups, and topics.
**Notifications** — Real-time push and in-app notification feed.
**Profile** — View and edit your profile, set a status, and browse any member's wall, followers, and following.
**Bookmarks** — Save posts and organize them into collections.
**Verification** — Submit and track your verification status in-app.
**Groups** — Browse, search, and join from Explore; group feed, creation, settings, members, invites, and join requests.
**Settings** — Notification preferences, privacy controls, blocked-user management, and feedback.
**Premium via the App Store** — StoreKit purchase and restore. Subscriptions started on the web are managed on the web.
**Deep linking** — Posts, profiles, groups, and topics open natively from a shared link or a push notification; anything without a native screen falls back to the web.
**Only Me + scheduled posts** — Private notes and scheduled posting, same as the web.
**Discovery extras** — Online Now, Word of the Day, Daily Quote, and topic, category, and state feeds.
**Report and block** — Report sheets across every feed plus blocked-user management.
**Daily check-ins** — Native check-in composer, streaks, and day feeds. Leaderboards still open on the web.

chunks.title: Native additions and remaining web handoffs

items.text: **Chat / DMs** — Native inbox and conversation screens, direct and group chats, requests, media, reactions, read indicators, search, and notification muting.
**Article reading** — Native article discovery, reading, boosts, reactions, and comments. Writing and editing still open on the website.
**Native coins screens** — Balance, earnings, transfers, and receipts currently use the website. Native wallet and transfer screens remain planned.
**Native Crews** — Crew walls, membership, and management currently use the website. Native screens remain planned.
**Native Spaces** — Rooms, shared radio, watch parties, and room chat currently use the website. Native playback and participation remain planned.
**Native article writing** — Reading is native; drafting, rich-text editing, and publishing still require the website.
**Native leaderboards** — Check-in day feeds are native; check-in rankings still open on the website.

backlog.title: Later / backlog
backlog.description: Ideas and unfinished benefits without committed dates. Existing foundations are called out so they are not mistaken for missing features.

items.text: Change phone number (add new number, verify, make primary).
Email as second factor or account recovery.
**Session controls** — Existing sessions persist across launches and sign out everywhere works. Individual device/session management is tracked in Account & data.
**Read receipt privacy controls** — Read indicators already work in web and iOS chat. A member-controlled receipt toggle has not been implemented.
**Automated identity-provider verification** — The current flow is admin-reviewed. Provider onboarding and an automated approval/revocation lifecycle remain future work.
Alt text for images (accessibility and screen readers).
**Webster's 1828 Word of the Day** — A daily dictionary word and definition, on the web and in the iOS app.
**Inline word definitions** — Tap any word in a post or article to get its Webster's 1828 definition without leaving the page.
Deeper topics — follow topics, trending topics, and topic moderation (spam/abuse resistance).
**Sharing** — Copy links, web/native share sheets, and the iOS Share Extension are implemented. Dedicated per-network share shortcuts remain optional follow-up work.

**Email delivery depth** — Digests, notification emails, newsletters, audience selection, scheduling, and unsubscribe controls are implemented. Bounce/suppression webhooks and deeper delivery diagnostics remain incomplete.
Webhooks (v1) — Signed, retrying webhooks for key events (user, identity, content, billing).
Webhook expansion — more event types, per-endpoint filters, replay tooling, and a small developer portal.
**Coin uses beyond transfers** — Consider cosmetics or other non-ranking perks. Coins cannot currently be redeemed for features or paid reach; direct coin transfers already work.
**Coins leaderboard** — Top coin holders and top earners this week so the economy has visible social proof.
**Gift premium** — Pay for someone else's subscription; send them a month or more of premium as a gift.
**Quarterly billing** — A quarterly subscription option is not implemented. The earlier $65 proposal remains unconfirmed.
**Annual billing** — An annual subscription option is not implemented. The earlier $250 proposal remains unconfirmed.
**Founding member plan** — A limited lifetime offer is an idea, not an available purchase or committed price.
**Lead magnet funnel** — Collect emails and convert to Premium through content upgrades (guides, frameworks, trackers).
**Acquisition channels** — Targeted podcasts, YouTube, aligned creators/influencers, paid ads targeting men's growth interests.
**Structured cohorts & facilitated programming** — Monthly structured conversations, accountability systems, small group cohorts, workshops & live calls.
Stewards-only forum.
Founder updates and quarterly Steward calls (strategy, philosophy, Q&A).
Early access to new features / betas.
Priority support, faster moderation review (same outcomes), and priority account recovery.
**Steward experience upgrades** — Additional feed defaults and advanced mute / filter controls remain planned. Ad-free use already applies to everyone.
**Steward limits and longform tools** — Higher media limits, more drafts, extended editing, and additional reading/writing tools remain planned; current limits are shared with Premium.
**Steward community tools** — Higher group caps and broader event / RSVP tools remain planned. Premium can already create private groups; Spaces already support scheduling and reminders.
**Purchasable customizations** — Themes, profile accents, or other app/profile customizations you can buy to personalize your experience.
**Profile identity and streaks** — Verification, paid membership styling, Premium+ glow, and streak indicators are implemented. A broader contribution and achievement badge system remains planned.
**Simple games** — Lightweight games for logged-in users to play with one another (e.g. quick challenges or mini-games in-app).
Tip or support a creator — One-time payment to another member (optional).
**Achievement badges** — Contribution and milestone awards beyond current identity and streak indicators.
**Keyboard shortcuts** — Power-user keyboard shortcuts for navigation, composing, and interacting with posts.
**Online presence / who's online** — See who's currently active on the platform in real-time.

footerDisclaimer: Original milestone dates are historical targets, not new delivery promises. Done means implemented in the current app; platform limits and limited rollouts are called out. Planned benefits are not included as available features. Remaining work has no committed release date.
metaDescription: Men of Hunger roadmap, updated September 16, 2026: current web and iOS features, App Store readiness, privacy controls, native gaps, and planned membership benefits.
